title: Scaling Vision Transformers Without Training: Prune-and-Merge Token Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.18039v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision Transformers achieve strong performance but incur high computational costs from quadratic token interactions. Training-free token reduction methods improve efficiency, but their robustness remains underexplored. We propose Prune-and Merge ViT, a training-free framework for off-the-shelf models. It combines class attention-based pruning with similarity-based merging to reduce redundancy while preserving semantic information. To evaluate robustness we introduce two metrics. Relative Accuracy Drop (RAD) measures relative accuracy degradation under transformations, and Prediction Flip Rate (PFR) quantifies prediction consistency. On pretrained ViT and DeiT, Prune-and-Merge reduces computation competitively while maintaining robustness and better accuracy than existing token reduction methods. Our analysis suggests that hybrid token reduction does not introduce hallucination-like behavior and preserves prediction stability for common

translated_title: 无需训练即可扩展视觉Transformer：剪枝-合并Token压缩
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer实现了强大的性能，但由于二次方复杂度的Token交互而带来高昂的计算成本。免训练的Token缩减方法可以提高效率，但其鲁棒性仍未得到充分研究。我们提出了Prune-and-Merge ViT，这是一个面向现成模型的免训练框架。它将基于类别注意力的剪枝与基于相似度的合并相结合，在减少冗余的同时保留语义信息。为了评估鲁棒性，我们引入了两个指标：相对准确率下降（RAD）衡量变换下的相对准确率退化程度，预测翻转率（PFR）量化预测一致性。在预训练的ViT和DeiT上，Prune-and-Merge在降低计算量方面具有竞争力，同时保持了鲁棒性，并比现有Token缩减方法取得更好的准确率。我们的分析表明，混合式Token缩减不会引入类似幻觉的行为，并保持了常见情况下的预测稳定性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的Prune-and-Merge ViT框架，通过结合基于类别注意力的剪枝与基于相似度的Token合并来压缩视觉Transformer，在保持鲁棒性、预测稳定性和不引入幻觉行为的前提下，实现了计算成本的有效降低和准确率的提升。
